name: io.github.bbik52/docmost-mcp-remote
title: Docmost (self-hosted)
description: Self-hosted remote MCP server for Docmost CE: members read and edit the wiki as themselves

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL of this server: http://localhost:8000 locally, or the https URL of your reverse proxy

environmentVariables.name: DOCMOST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Docmost, Community Edition 0.70.0 or newer

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres URL for the server's own data, e.g. postgresql://user:password@host/db

environmentVariables.name: SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Random value of at least 32 characters; encrypts stored Docmost sessions
